title: Taylor Swift-Travis Kelce wedding on July 4? Report fuels buzz over New York ceremony
summary: Fresh speculation surrounding Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding has taken over social media after a report linked permits, hotel bookings and preparations in New York City to a possible ceremony in early July.
